interview.name: Mina
interview.answer: I don’t have the current time or location for the repair drive from these notes.

reflections: Mina is actively coordinating the repair drive and wants confirmation from multiple people before proceeding.
Nell communicates cautious uncertainty and is waiting for an update rather than asserting details.
Hana is being deliberate about verifying the list first, which suggests the group is relying on her for the confirmed logistics.
Mina is the main coordinator, repeatedly checking status and asking others for the confirmed update.
Hana and Nell are cautious and responsive, preferring to verify details before sharing them.
Oren is willing to help but may need practical reminders, suggesting he is less up to speed on the logistics.
Mina is waiting on the same update from multiple people and is relying on others to relay it quickly.
Nell, Ira, and Opal are cooperative and responsive, each offering to check around or report back when they learn more.
The group communication is calm and coordinated, with Mina repeatedly confirming she wants immediate notification when anything changes.
Mina is coordinating with multiple people and depends on timely updates about the repair drive and event status.
Opal, Nell, Ira, and Rosa are acting as responsive status relays, keeping others informed as soon as they know more.
The group is managing a community-center repair drive with urgency around movement, official confirmation, and prioritizing urgent fixes.
Mina is coordinating timing and logistics across multiple people, especially around pickup/drop-off windows and repair drive updates.
Rosa appears to be the main organizer for the weekend community-center event and is handling urgent issues for others.
The group relies on status-checking and quick handoffs, with several people waiting on updates before they can act.

events.text: Mina: Hey Nell, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Nell: I think so — I’m pretty sure it’s still happening, but I’m waiting on the latest update. Did anything change?
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Mina: Not that I’ve heard. I just wanted to check whether you’d heard the latest yet.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Mina: Hey Hana, what’s the latest on the repair drive?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Hana: I’m checking the details first so I don’t miss anything — once I’ve confirmed the list, I’ll let you know the latest.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Mina: Got it — can you send me the confirmed list when you have it?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Mina: Hey Oren, have you heard the latest on the repair drive yet?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Oren: Oh right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, though I may need a reminder on where we’re meeting.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Mina: I haven’t heard a confirmed update yet—do you want me to send the meeting spot once I get it?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Mina: I haven’t heard anything new yet—just checking if you’ve gotten the official update.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Nell: Not yet—I’m still waiting on the official update too. I’ll ask around and let you know if I hear anything new.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell — appreciate it. Keep me posted if you hear back.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Ira: I still haven’t heard any new updates, but I’m keeping an ear out while I run errands.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira — if you hear anything, please let me know right away.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll let you know right away if I hear anything about the repair drive.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Opal: I’m still by the community center checking whether the repair drive has moved. If I spot any change, I’ll let everyone know right away.
events.speaker: Opal

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Mina: Thanks, Opal — I’ll wait for your update. If it moves, please tell me where it’s headed.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Opal: I will — I’m watching here closely, and I’ll let you know if it moves and where it goes.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Nell: I still haven’t heard the official update, but I’ll let you know as soon as I do.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell — appreciate it. Keep me posted if you hear back.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Nell: Will do — I’m keeping an ear out and will pass it along as soon as I hear anything official.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Rosa: Absolutely — it’s still on this weekend, Sunday at the community center. If you’ve got any urgent fixes for Mina to flag, send them my way and I’ll keep them at the top.
events.speaker: Rosa

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Mina: Great, thanks Rosa — I’ll keep that in mind. I’ll send over anything urgent for Mina to flag.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll keep the urgent ones lined up and make sure nothing gets missed. Just send them over when you’re ready.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Mina: Thanks, Opal — I’m waiting on your update. If it moves, please tell me where it’s headed.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Opal: I’m still by the community center checking whether the repair drive has moved. If it changes, I’ll let you know right away.
events.speaker: Opal

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Mina: Thanks, Opal — I’m still waiting. If it moves, please let me know where it goes.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Faye: Of course — send me the latest pickup and drop-off windows, and I’ll work around them so the repair drive stays smooth.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Mina: I’m checking the pickup and drop-off windows now and I’ll send them over as soon as I have them.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Faye: Thanks, Mina — I’ll be ready to adjust around them once you send the times.
events.speaker: Faye
